subject: Perplexity-based GPT-2 filter
source_sentence: Perplexity-based GPT-2 filter: An unsupervised method where the average GPT-2 perplexity of each abstract is computed. A threshold is applied to classify texts as AI-generated or human-written based on their likelihood scores.
